meta.title: The Science Fair
meta.blurb: Maya and Theo built a robot for the IFAL science fair. The day before the fair, it stopped working... You decide what they do!
meta.choicePrompt: What do Maya and Theo do?

p1.title: The Broken Robot
text: On Thursday night, Maya and Theo finished their robot. Its name was Bolt. It was small and blue, and it could move its arms and say “Hello!”
The IFAL science fair was on Saturday. The first prize was a trip to a big science museum.
On Friday morning, Maya pressed the button. Suddenly, Bolt made a strange noise, and a little [[smoke|fumaça]] came out of its body. Then it stopped.
“Oh no!” said Theo. “The fair is tomorrow!”

p2a.title: A Long Night
text: That night, Maya and Theo opened Bolt on the kitchen table. First, they checked the batteries. They were OK. Then they looked at the small motor in Bolt's arm. It was black, and it smelled bad.
“The motor burned,” said Maya. “We need a new one.”
Theo remembered his old toy car. “My toy car has a motor too,” he said. “But it is very old and weak.”

p2b.title: Professora Rita
text: Maya and Theo ran to the lab with Bolt. Professora Rita, the physics teacher, opened the robot with a small [[screwdriver|chave de fenda]].
“Look,” she said. “The motor burned. You need a new motor before tomorrow.”
Then she wrote two ideas on the board. First, the big market in the city center sells motors. Second, Seu Bento, an old repair man, can fix almost everything.

p3x.title: The Toy Car
text: Theo opened his old toy car and took out the motor. First, they cleaned it. Then they put it in Bolt's arm. It was difficult, and it took two hours.
Finally, Maya pressed the button. Bolt moved! But it moved very slowly, and it made a funny noise: brrr... brrr...
“It works,” said Theo, “but it isn't very good.” It was already eleven o'clock.

p3y.title: At the Market
text: On Friday afternoon, Maya and Theo went to the big market. After a long search, they found a small shop with motors, cables and old radios.
“This motor is perfect for your robot,” said the seller. “It's forty reais.”
Maya and Theo had only twenty-five reais. Then Theo called his big brother, Caíque. “I can [[lend|emprestar]] you the money,” said Caíque, “but you have to wash my car on Saturday morning.”
Maya looked at Theo. Maybe a simpler robot was a better idea.

p3z.title: Seu Bento's Shop
text: Seu Bento's shop was small and full of old clocks, radios and TVs. He looked at Bolt's motor for a long time.
“I can fix it,” he said, “but I need a special part. It arrives tomorrow at eight o'clock.”
The fair started at nine. Maya was worried. Then Theo had an idea: “Or we can build a simpler robot tonight.”

p4a.title: No Sleep
text: Maya and Theo worked all night. First, they changed the wheels. Then they painted Bolt again. At five in the morning, Bolt moved fast and said “Hello!” again.
But Maya and Theo were very, very tired. Their eyes were red, and Theo fell asleep on the kitchen table.
The fair started at nine.

p4b.title: In Front of the Judges
text: On Saturday, the IFAL gym was full of tables, posters and people. Maya and Theo put Bolt on their table. It wasn't the robot of their dreams: it was slow and simple.
Later, three [[judges|jurados]] came to their table. “Tell us about your robot,” said one of them.
Theo looked at Maya. She was nervous. What could they say?

p4c.title: A Deal with Caíque
text: Caíque lent them the money, and they bought the motor. That night, they put it in Bolt. Bolt worked perfectly!
On Saturday morning, Maya and Theo washed Caíque's car. Then they ran to the fair with Bolt in a box.
At the fair, a group of children saw Bolt. “Can we play with it?” they asked.

p4d.title: Eight O'Clock
text: On Saturday, Maya and Theo arrived at Seu Bento's shop at seven thirty. They waited and waited. Finally, at eight o'clock, a man arrived on a motorcycle with the part.
Seu Bento worked fast. At eight forty, Bolt moved its arms and said “Hello!” Everybody smiled.
But the fair started at nine, and the school was far.

e1.title: First Prize!
text: Bolt worked perfectly in front of the judges. It moved its arms, said “Hello!” and gave a small flag to one of the judges.
In the end, the director read the results: “First prize... Maya and Theo, with Bolt!” Everybody clapped, and Maya and Theo laughed and jumped.
e1.event: Maya and Theo won first prize
e1.eventPt: a Maya e o Theo ganharam o primeiro prêmio

e2.title: The Best Story
text: Maya told the judges everything: the smoke, the burned motor and the long night. Theo showed them the old motor.
The judges smiled. “Robots break. Good engineers don't give up,” said one of them. In the end, Bolt didn't win first prize, but Maya and Theo won a special prize for their hard work.

question.q: Why did they win a special prize?

e3.title: Sleepy Scientists
text: Bolt worked well at the fair, and many people liked it. But in front of the judges, Maya forgot her words, and Theo fell asleep on his chair!
In the end, they got third place. “Next time, we sleep before the fair,” said Maya with a smile.

question.q: Who fell asleep in front of the judges?

e4.title: The Juice Accident
text: The children loved Bolt. They played with it for twenty minutes. Suddenly, a little boy dropped his juice on the robot. Bolt made a noise and stopped.
When the judges arrived, Bolt didn't work. Maya and Theo didn't win a prize, but the children's school invited them to show Bolt to their class.

e5.title: Too Late
text: Maya and Theo arrived at the fair at ten fifteen. The judges were leaving the gym.
“Sorry,” said Professora Rita. “The presentations ended at ten.” Bolt worked perfectly, but the judges didn't see it. On the bus home, Theo said, “Next year, we start earlier.”

question.q: Where were the judges when Maya and Theo arrived?

e6.title: Not Perfect
text: “Bolt is perfect,” said Theo. “It is very fast.” Then a judge pressed the button. Bolt moved very, very slowly: brrr... brrr...
The judges looked at each other. They didn't believe Theo anymore, and they didn't give Bolt a prize. Later, Maya said, “We needed to tell the truth.”
